text:
alex: Heads-up: quick API Q — streaming toolcall partials. Are we requiring the runtime to emit a final consolidated 'tool_call' event with full args, or do we expect clients to reassemble from deltas? Need a decision for the SDK linter change.

kathy: My vote is emit the final consolidated event. Too many clients (mobile/embedded) won't reassemble reliably.

mike: Agree with @kathy. Also we should be careful about nullable 'role' in midstream message chunks — clients expect role to remain present. Don't return null for role.

schema-bot: :warning: sdk-lint: streaming-toolcall-no-final-event detected. 1 failing thread. See https://git.internal/rules/stream-toolcall for more.

alex: Proposal: runtime will emit an explicit 'tool_call_complete' (eventType) as the final streaming delta that includes the consolidated `args` object, plus a final `message` with role="assistant" and a meta pointer: `meta.tool_call_ref`. Clients that need to reconstruct can still use deltas, but SDKs/linters will require the final event for compatibility. Example stream snippet:```
{ "event": "tool_call_start", "tool": "search", "args_partial": { "q": "does redwood" } }
{ "event": "tool_call_arg_delta", "args_partial": { "filters": { "lang": "en" } } }
{ "event": "tool_call_complete", "tool": "search", "args": { "q": "does redwood", "filters": { "lang": "en" } }, "final": true }
{ "event": "message", "role": "assistant", "content": "<tool_call:search:12345>", "meta": { "tool_call_ref": "12345" } }
``` 
This keeps streaming efficient but gives a clear compatibility contract. Also proposing header `X-Compat-Emit-ToolComplete: true|false` for opt-out during canary.

kathy: SGTM. Add TTL on partial arg deltas so we don't leak KV cache if a client disconnects. Also `final: true` field on the complete event sounds good.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll draft the spec PR + add the linter rule change to require the final event unless opt-out header present. Will add tests for role non-null and the `final` boolean.

alex: Thanks — assigning to @mike. @kathy can you add a short note to on-call runbook about potential regression post-rollout (clients that ignore final event)?

kathy: Yep I'll add a blurb and a quick verification checklist.

mike: ETA for PR by end of day tomorrow, ping me if you see anything odd in the linter job logs.

alex: Great. Closing this thread once PR is up. :rocket:
